newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat to leave for Malta on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to leave for Malta on Tuesday.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will leave Cairo for Malta on Tuesday to take part in a meeting of European and Mediterranean foreign ministers, Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa said on Monday.
Arafat is expected to use the meeting as a chance to tell the ministers that Israel's settlement policy in East Jerusalem is the main reason regional peace talks have collapsed.
The Palestinian leader met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in Cairo on Monday for talks on the troubles facing the Middle East peace process.
Israel said on Monday Arafat had expressed interest in meeting Foreign Minister David Levy at the Malta talks to defuse the crisis in peace talks.
But PLO officials said the Palestinian leader has ruled out a meeting with Levy at this stage.
The PLO has said resumption of peace talks depended on freezing work that began on March 18 at Jabal Abu Ghneim, the Jerusalem hilltop where 6,500 homes for Jews are planned.
Palestinians have clashed with Israeli troops in the West Bank almost every day since work started there.
